name: God's Eye View
description: Fork of bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view: a browser spy-satellite simulator that turns public signals into a place. A vanilla-JS CesiumJS globe on Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles renders thirteen live layers (OpenSky/adsb.lol flights, AISStream vessels, CelesTrak satellites via SGP4, USGS earthquakes, TomTom/OSM traffic, ~800 projected public cameras, Radio Browser stations, GBFS bikeshare, NASA FIRMS fires, Launch Library 2 missions, OSM military installations) plus bundled datacenters, dams and submarine cables, with cockpit view, sensor-look shaders, detection overlay, scene director and an OpenAI Realtime voice agent. The server is a set of Vite dev/preview middlewares under /api/* that broker keys, cache and budget upstream calls; there is no database and nothing is stored beyond caches. In the Notations Universe it is a rendering dock and a reference for honest freshness labelling (live, delayed, simulated, unavailable); it must never become a state holder or an intelligence record.

capabilities.label: Photorealistic 3D globe
capabilities.description: Principal view: CesiumJS globe on Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles (Bing via Cesium ion or OSM as alternates) with thirteen toggleable live layers, click-to-track, cockpit view, contacts roster, GLSL sensor styles (CRT, NVG, FLIR, Noir, Snow), detection overlay, military HUD, scene director and share links.

capabilities.label: Live flights
capabilities.description: Server-side /api/opensky proxy (OAuth / basic / anonymous, credit governor, last-good cache) with a bounded adsb.lol point-snapshot fallback; /api/opensky-track and /api/adsblol/trace return flown tracks; /api/adsbdb resolves aircraft identity. Rendered one poll interval behind real time with interpolation.

capabilities.label: Military flights
capabilities.description: /api/adsblol/mil proxies adsb.lol military ADS-B traffic, rendered in amber.

capabilities.label: Live vessels (AIS)
capabilities.description: /api/ais-live serves vessel positions from a server-held AISStream websocket (AISSTREAM_API_KEY, configurable bounding boxes and silence watchdog); layer reports partial/delayed/unavailable states.

capabilities.label: Satellites (SGP4)
capabilities.description: /api/celestrak proxies and disk-caches CelesTrak TLEs; the client propagates an ~840-object core catalog (DENSE chip adds the Starlink shell) with SGP4 and GMST-locked orbit rings.

capabilities.label: Earthquakes (24h)
capabilities.description: Client fetches the USGS all-day GeoJSON feed directly (no server proxy) and renders global seismic activity for the last 24 h.

capabilities.label: Traffic flow
capabilities.description: /api/overpass proxies OpenStreetMap road geometry and /api/tomtom/flow/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf proxies TomTom flow vector tiles under a daily tile budget; keyless the layer runs a labeled simulation.
capabilities.provenance: TomTom + OSM Overpass, or simulation when keyless

capabilities.label: CCTV mesh
capabilities.description: /api/cctv lists ~800 public cameras (Austin Open Data, Caltrans, TfL JamCams; config/cctv_sources.*.json) and /api/cctv/frame/{id} and /api/cctv/media/{id} proxy frames and streams; cameras are projected into the 3D scene with estimated poses and a viewshed mode.

capabilities.label: Geolocated radio
capabilities.description: /api/radio/stations discovers Radio Browser mirrors and returns up to 750 geolocated HTTPS stations (45-min cache); the analog tuner flies the globe to each broadcaster and reports click counts back.

capabilities.label: Bikeshare availability
capabilities.description: /api/gbfs proxies GBFS station feeds (Lyft / BCycle) for live dock availability.

capabilities.label: Active fires (NASA FIRMS)
capabilities.description: /api/firms proxies VIIRS active-fire CSV (three sensors, trailing 24 h) with FIRMS_MAP_KEY; rendered as heatmap and anchors, with hand-off to the nearest live camera.

capabilities.label: Space missions (30d)
capabilities.description: /api/launches makes a rolling 30-day Launch Library 2 query (payload, stage, recovery detail), cached 15 min in memory and on disk; LL2_API_TOKEN optional. Ascent playback is marked RECONSTRUCTED ESTIMATE.

capabilities.label: Mapped installations (OSM)
capabilities.description: /api/military-installations returns viewport-bounded (max 10 degrees) allow-listed OSM military=* and landuse=military features, cached, labeled as incomplete community mapping.

capabilities.label: Bundled static infrastructure
capabilities.description: Datacenters (4,351), dams (704) and TeleGeography submarine cables (712, CC BY-NC-SA carve-out) shipped with the app and drawn as world overlays; reachable by hand and by voice.

capabilities.label: Regional briefing
capabilities.description: /api/regional-brief returns a cached place label (Nominatim), current weather (Open-Meteo) and location-matched headlines (Google News RSS with GDELT DOC fallback) for the cockpit Local Info and Regional News pages.

capabilities.label: Camera-local weather effects
capabilities.description: /api/weather-effects returns Open-Meteo observations around the camera to drive the opt-in volumetric WX cloud effect.

capabilities.label: Ellipsoidal height lookup
capabilities.description: /api/terrain/heights resolves ground heights at points from Re:Earth keyless terrain (EGM2008 geoid) so entities sit on the rendered terrain.

capabilities.label: Route drawing
capabilities.description: /api/route resolves a route between two places for the voice whiteboard and the fly-the-route cinematic.

capabilities.label: Google Places search (metered)
capabilities.description: /api/google/nearby-places and /api/google/text-search broker Google Places queries server-side for voice scene context and on-demand installation search; opt-in per-IP throttle GEV_RATELIMIT_GOOGLE_PER_MIN. Spends the operator's Google quota.

capabilities.label: Voice agent session token
capabilities.description: /api/realtime/token mints a short-lived OpenAI Realtime session (model, voice, context window from env) so the browser can talk to the globe through 28 tools; /api/realtime/debug-log receives client diagnostics. Spends OpenAI credit.

capabilities.label: AI HUD summary
capabilities.description: /api/openai/hud-summary returns a terse scene summary for the HUD via OPENAI_HUD_SUMMARY_MODEL; throttled by GEV_RATELIMIT_OPENAI_PER_MIN.

capabilities.label: Share links
capabilities.description: Camera, style, layers and one tracked target serialize into a URL so a live target can be handed off to another viewer.

capabilities.label: Scene director
capabilities.description: Captures and plays cinematic camera tours (recipes such as Orbital Watch) for clips and demos.

capabilities.label: QA and regression scripts
capabilities.description: npm test runs the unit suite; scripts/qa-*.mjs drive Puppeteer captures for layers, cockpit, traffic, voice routing and performance; npm run opensky:import imports OpenSky credentials.

reference.spatial: Whole-Earth 3D globe; every layer is geolocated and the CCTV mesh is calibrated for Austin, California and London; bundled infrastructure is global.
reference.temporal: Live feeds polled every 15-30 s and rendered one interval behind real time; earthquakes and fires trail 24 h, launches 30 days; caches only, nothing archived.
open_questions: The /api/* surface exists only inside Vite dev/preview middlewares; is there an intended production server for the Notations deployment?
OpenSky's non-commercial licence and the TeleGeography CC BY-NC-SA cables constrain any commercial use inside the Universe.
No Notations-specific changes are visible on the fork; treat as a pure upstream mirror until a diverging commit appears.
